properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key for generating and validating JWT tokens.

properties.name: security.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token expiration duration in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.otp.expiry-minutes
properties.description: Time duration in minutes for which OTP remains valid.

properties.name: app.mail.from
properties.description: Email address to use as the sender for outbound mail notifications.

properties.name: app.notifications.ticket-base-url
properties.description: Base URL for tickets, used in email/notification links.

properties.name: app.notifications.retry-base-delay-ms
properties.description: Base delay in milliseconds for retrying failed notification dispatches.

properties.name: app.captcha.enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables reCAPTCHA validation on authentication requests.

properties.name: google.recaptcha.secret
properties.description: Secret key for Google reCAPTCHA server-side validation.
